article.title: The Library Book Swap
article.content:
The library in Rosa’s town started a book swap. Visitors could bring one book they no longer needed and take another home for free. Rosa wanted to join, but she did not know which book to bring. Her favourite story had notes from her grandmother inside it, so she decided to keep it. Instead, she chose a nature book that she had already read twice.

At the library, a volunteer checked that the pages were clean and complete. Rosa placed her book on a table and found a short story collection. She also noticed a child choosing her nature book. On the way home, Rosa felt pleased: she had something new to read, and her old book had found another reader.
article.translation:
罗莎镇上的图书馆开始举办图书交换。读者可以带一本不再需要的书，免费换另一本带回家。罗莎想参加，却不知道该带哪本。她最喜欢的故事书里有奶奶的批注，因此决定保留。她改选了一本已经读过两遍的自然知识书。

在图书馆，志愿者检查书页是否干净、完整。罗莎把书放在桌上，找到一本短篇小说集。她还看到一个孩子选中了她的自然知识书。回家路上，她很高兴：自己有了新书读，旧书也找到了另一位读者。

questions.prompt: Why did Rosa keep her favourite story?
options: It was the only book she had
questions.explanation: 她保留这本书是因为书中有奶奶的批注，而不是因为没有别的书。

options: Whether the pages were clean and complete
questions.explanation: 第二段首句直接说明了志愿者检查的内容。

options: Both she and another reader gained a book to read
questions.explanation: 末句说明她有新书可读，旧书也找到了新读者。交换活动不涉及卖书。
